provider_catalog_description: Manage reference profiles by category. The catalog does not store credentials, enable checkout, deploy, or change runtime.
adapter_warning_title: Adapter status does not mean connection status.
adapter_warning_body: ‘Adapter available’ only confirms that the backend has a corresponding flow; configuration and credentials are managed outside the catalog. Providers without an adapter are clearly marked and cannot be activated here.
backend_missing: The backend does not have the catalog API.
backend_missing_help: Deploy a backend version with the /api/settings/providers routes to preview or staging, then try again. No sample data is shown.
catalog_load_help: Check the connection and Super Admin permissions, then try again.
registry_profiles_help: The items below are providers in the registry, not catalog profiles. Select one to create and save a profile.
registry_allowlist_help: Only providers in the registry allowlist can be created.
catalog_reference_help: Reference information for this profile only; it does not affect runtime configuration. Do not enter API keys, tokens, passwords, or secrets.
credentials_catalog_warning: Do not store credentials in the catalog. Use the separate provider configuration.
config_fields_help: Enter the exact values for the displayed keys. Use sandbox/staging only; credentials are encrypted by the backend and do not activate an adapter or deploy automatically.
secrets_unavailable: The secrets store is not ready. The backend must configure an encryption key before credentials can be saved.
saved_rotate_placeholder: Saved — enter a new value to rotate
catalog_config_warning: The catalog only stores profiles; saving configuration does not mean the provider is connected or the adapter is ready.
profile_save_partial: Profile saved, but configuration was not saved:
profile_hard_delete_error: Unable to permanently delete the profile.
runtime_backend_old: The backend is running an older version and is routing the runtime API incorrectly. Update the backend and restart the service.
runtime_read_error: Unable to read provider runtime configuration.
cloudflare_save_error: Unable to save Cloudflare AI configuration.
schema_load_error: Unable to load the configuration schema.
audit_load_error: Unable to load the audit log.
edit_profile_error: Unable to load the profile for editing.
runtime_not_catalog: Runtime values are not catalog profiles.
runtime_unlinked: No runtime configuration is linked to this provider. No values are inferred or taken from sample credentials.
no_runtime_keys: No runtime keys are configured for this provider.
vnpay_runtime_help: Configuration is encrypted and applied immediately on the backend. Changing the Hash Secret can prevent callbacks for older transactions from being verified. Update the IPN URL separately in the VNPay admin portal.
credential_store_unavailable: Credential encryption store is not ready.
configured_replace_placeholder: Configured — enter a new value to replace
cloudflare_runtime_help: Edit individual runtime keys. Values are encrypted in the database and applied directly; saved tokens are retained when left blank.
configured_replace_keep_placeholder: Configured — enter a new value to replace, or leave blank to keep it
vnpay_runtime_warning: VNPay configuration is encrypted and applied immediately; changing the Hash Secret may prevent pending transaction callbacks from being verified.
cloudflare_runtime_warning: Cloudflare AI overrides are encrypted in the database, take precedence over environment variables, and apply immediately. Leave tokens blank when editing to keep their current values.
runtime_env_readonly: This is configuration read from the current backend process. To change it, update environment variables where the service is deployed and restart it; the catalog does not edit `.env`.
catalog_connection_warning: The catalog does not report connection status or transaction-processing capability.
config_sections_help: Reference information in the catalog and runtime configuration are shown separately.
runtime_backend_unavailable: The backend is not returning runtime data. Check the provider-configs/runtime route.
select_profile_help: View saved fields, integration status, and change history.
soft_delete_body: ” will be moved to deleted items. The audit log will be retained.
hard_delete_body: ” and its linked credential configuration will be permanently deleted. The audit log will be retained; this action cannot be undone.
delete_config_confirm_body: This only deletes the provider key/value configuration, not the catalog profile. Re-enter your Super Admin password to confirm.
